records.fitting_set: ANN classifier and predictors trained on E-WMLES (charLES, exact-for-the-mean SGS model and exact wall-stress p.d.f.) of the building-block flows: Freestream; laminar Poiseuille flow Re_tau = 5 to 1e4 (analytical parabolic profile); turbulent channels Re_tau = 100 to 10,000 (ZPG); turbulent Poiseuille-Couette flow with Re_P from -1.2e3 to 1.2e3 and Re_U from 5e3 to 2e4 (FPG, APG, Separation); channels with sudden spanwise pressure gradient, Re_tau = 100 to 1000 and Pi = 5 to 100 (Unsteady). selection_decisions.decision: Length of the E-WMLES training runs (10 eddy turnovers; not below 3)

selection_decisions.decision: Test set (20% of the data) made of full cases at Reynolds numbers and Pi values absent from the training set
selection_decisions.data_used: 'This was found to improve the predictive capability of the network when interpolating and extrapolating among unseen cases'; the unseen cases are not named

selection_decisions.decision: Network layouts (classifier 5 hidden layers x 20 neurons; predictors 5 x 30)

selection_decisions.decision: Training data generated by E-WMLES in the deployment solver instead of filtered DNS, with an enlarged set of seven building-block flows
selection_decisions.data_used: Argument on the inconsistency of filtered DNS with implicitly filtered LES (Sec. 2.5); Sec. 4.8 reports that the present version is more accurate on the NASA Juncture Flow than the preliminary version trained with filtered DNS and fewer building blocks.
